neha: Heads-up 32 bringing Polaris-v2-lite (int4 strict profile) into staging caused a multilingual quality regression affecting CJK punctuation spacing and RTL isolation. Need triage.
neha: Baseline fp16 zh->en BLEU 29.8, polaris-int4 BLEU 25.6 on bench/xx_to_en_1k. he->en dropped ~3.4 pts.
neha: Repro we used:
```
# snapshot polaris-2026-04-01
python eval/translate.py --model polaris-v2-lite --quant int4 --dataset bench/xx_to_en_1k.jsonl --batch 24
```
neha: Quick examples — note spacing around ideographic comma and missing RLI in Hebrew.
```
src:   \u4ed60\u3001
fp16: He paused, then asked, "Are we ready?"
int4: He paused , then asked , \" Are we ready ? \"
```
neha: Hebrew snippet shows bracket ordering weirdness around embedded English: paren order flips when int4 detok runs.

taro: Could be normalization/fast-detok in the int4 kernel. Any kernel tag used?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Staging canary used kernel tag `kernels/text/fastnorm-2026-04-01` deployed 2026-04-01T07:12Z. Tokenizer package unchanged.

neha: Thanks. eva can you dump tokenization + detok traces for a few failing examples?

eva: Pasted short trace for the Chinese example:
```
# token ids (snippet)
fp16 ids: [412, 81, 7002, 19, 990]
int4 ids: [412, 81, 7002, 19, 990]
# detok logs (int4):
norm: collapse U+200D at pos 17
norm: insert_space before U+3001 at pos 8
norm: drop U+2067 at pos 3
```
eva: So token ids match; modifications happen in detok/normalization.

dmitri: Dropping U+2067 (RLI) explains RTL isolation breaks; collapsing U+200D explains CJK joiner loss; inserting spaces before U+3001 (ideographic comma) explains spacing delta. Looks like fastnorm aggressively treats these as whitespace/punctuation.

neha: Quick mitigation idea: re-run int4 with env TEXT_NORMALIZE=unicode_compat or runtime flag `--preserve-control-chars`. If BLEU recovers we can blame kernel policy.

eva: Running a 1k eval with TEXT_NORMALIZE=unicode_compat now, ETA ~10m.

# short status
eva: Done. unicode_compat int4 BLEU zh->en = 29.6 (close to fp16). he->en also within 0.3 pts.
taro: Confirms normalization policy in `fastnorm-2026-04-01`. We should pin int4 to previous stable kernel for production.

dmitri: I'll open kernel issue with minimal repros and attach detok logs (issue #4410). Patch suggestion: make control-char handling opt-out and whitelist RLI/LRI/ZWJ/ZWNJ/U+3001 spacing rules.

neha: Action items: @dmitri open kernel bug + PR; @taro prepare rollback PR to `kernels/text/stable-2026-03`; @eva add eval fixture `fixtures/locale_controls_20.jsonl` to regression suite and add a canary gate.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback to `kernels/text/stable-2026-03` started 2026-04-01T08:05Z for canary group polaris-canary-1.

taro: Also adding telemetry: count of dropped control-chars per model/quant and alert if >1 per 1k tokens.

neha: Good. Longer-term we may expose an API option for aggressive ascii-first normalization for customers that want it. Default must preserve control and bidi marks.

dmitri: I'll push a small unit test to runtime that fails if detok emits "drop U+200D" for any language in our multilingual fixtures.

eva: Uploaded PRs and linked issue in the kernel repo. Tagging reviewers.

neha: Thanks team. Keep updates here and tag me on PRs. :eyes:
